## Passages
RESULT [curation]: Smaller, more stringently filtered datasets can generalize better than larger ones from the same pool. At 12.8B scale the best baseline improves ImageNet zero-shot by 6.9 pp over the unfiltered pool. DataComp-1B trains a CLIP ViT-L/14 to 79.2%, 3.7 pp above OpenAI's CLIP ViT-L/14 at the same compute.
US [curation]: The methodological lesson is to fix the trainer and vary only the curation step when comparing filters. The project's DINOv2 threshold and curator choice have never been evaluated that way against a fixed YOLO recipe. The CLIP-score filtering itself does not transfer directly, because harvested detection data has boxes rather than captions.
CORRECTION [curation]: NeurIPS 2023 D&B confirmed. The paper reports 'over three hundred baseline experiments'. Smaller, more stringently filtered datasets generalize better. +6.9 pp ImageNet at 12.8B over the unfiltered pool. DataComp-1B ViT-L/14 reaches 79.2%, +3.7 pp over OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14.
